d: Kim puts her own spin on the legendary television show, 'Dallas,'  by imagining her family and friends as the twisted characters from the primetime series of lust and greed.
After a minor spat with Nikki gets blown way out of proportion, Kim spendsThanksgiving alone.
Nikki tries out for cheerleading and Professor Oglevee tries too hard to be hip.
Nikki and the handsome new Pastor of her church make beautiful music together.
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.
After spending the summer traveling with Q’s band, Moesha returns home sporting an engagement ring.
Someone places a hidden camera in Moesha and Niecy’s dorm room; Myles’ girlfriend tells him she’s pregnant—and he’s the father!
While Frank and Dorian are on a road trip to Vegas, Myles falls hard for Moesha’s roommate, Alicia.
Nikki uncovers a shocking secret about her family, while Kim and Stevie try to live without the use of African-American inventions.
Nikki fears that Kim may have been switched at birth, and the Professor’s late uncle has a tough time resting in peace.
If you think Nikki’s wild about Professor Oglevee, wait till you meet her grandmother!
Nikki’s new friend becomes obsessed with her.
An accident causes Kim to lose her memory.
It’s Halloween and Moesha’s acting crazy, Niecy’s growing body hair, and Dorian’s dogsitting a ferocious bulldog.
A woman city council candidate loses Moesha’s support when she gets the hots for Hakeem.
When Moesha tells her dad she’s engaged, he fantasizes about solving his family problems like Bill Cosby.
Q comes home for Thanksgiving and asks Moesha for his ring back.
Moesha’s attempt to solve Niecy’s 'ain’t gotta man blues' backfires.
